_about: Round 121: the first half hour. One-time 'first times' that pay something small and say what comes next (scripts/systems/Opening.gd). A fight, a pickup, a choice and a reward all land in the first ten minutes.

milestones.text: FIRST BLOOD. The deep took notice, and some of what it held is yours now.
milestones.next: Next: choose a Path (menu > Path) -- who you are in a fight. It is free, and any road is open.

milestones.text: YOUR ROAD. Every kill, parry and shot of that kind now counts toward its first rank.
milestones.next: Rank 2 teaches your path's art (key 6 / PATH). The Path page shows exactly what it asks.

milestones.text: FIRST CHEST. Things are left in the deep for people who look.
FIRST STEP UP. Your body and qi are not what they were.
milestones.next: Sit (M) and the pill and your sea of qi will do the rest; the menu's You page shows what changed.

milestones.text: YOUR ART. A few seconds of what your path is for.
A FLOOR, END TO END. Each floor is graded, and a better grade pays the difference.
A GREAT FOE FALLS. The floor's master is down; the way below is open.
milestones.next: The deep goes much further. Elder Mo has more to say.
